name: ModLoader64
tagline: ModLoader64 is a network capable mod loading system for Nintendo 64 games
blurb: ModLoader64 is an advanced modding platform and online multiplayer framework built around Mupen64Plus.
description:
ModLoader64 is an advanced modding platform and online multiplayer framework built
around Mupen64Plus. It enables rich scripting, memory injection, and synchronised
multiplayer gameplay for Nintendo 64 games such as The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
and Majora's Mask.

Features include:

• Built-in online multiplayer netplay and room management

• Extensible TypeScript/JavaScript modding and plugin API

• Bundled Mupen64Plus emulator with modern graphics, audio, input, and RSP plugins

• Integrated GUI for configuring ROMs, game cores, and community mods

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
